contracts.web: admitSavedRows: printable ASCII 0x20..0x7E only; one terminator kind for the whole file (CRLF or LF); every line terminated; line 1 /^"[^"]*","[^"]*"$/ (each value <= 64 bytes, WEB); line 2 prefix + 0..4 bytes + '"'; line 3 blank; 0..4 lines '"' + 1..40 bytes + '"'; blank; exact header; >= 1 row. Metadata text is kept verbatim and never interpreted. WEB conservative limit: a '"' inside table/identity text is refused ('metadata-quote'). Bytes are copied at admission and only copies leave the module (savedRowsBytes); savedRowsReassemble rebuilds the identical bytes from the line texts.

A file appended to by later saves has more rows after the same header and is admitted as one list in file order. A truncation that ends exactly at a line boundary cannot be detected.

contracts.web: Each row is split at commas outside quotes; a quoted field ends at the next '"', which must be followed by ',' or the row end; any other '"' is refused ('row-quote'). Column classes: object quoted <= 40; frequency/gain/start/interval /^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?$/; reference/vertical same or '""'; horizontal /^-?[0-9](\.[0-9]+)?E[+-][0-9]+$/ or '""'; comment quoted <= 81; points /^-?[0-9]+$/; aperture /^[0-9]+$/; file quoted <= 255; each bare token <= 40 bytes; row <= 1024 bytes; <= 2000 rows (WEB). Field spellings and spans are kept verbatim; nothing becomes a Number. Dot-decimal only: a comma decimal separator splits fields and fails the column layout.
